description: This reference table lists all 205 NHS provider trusts in England, the organisations that run hospitals, mental health, community and ambulance services, with the codes and categories needed to join other NHS data sets together. The producer is Vsevolod Shabad of the University of Liverpool. NHS organisational data are published in many collections, including the Estates Returns Information Collection on buildings and facilities, the Data Security and Protection Toolkit, trust accounts and workforce statistics, each naming trusts differently and not always carrying the official Organisation Data Service code. The table gives each trust's code, type, NHS England sub-classification and foundation trust status; from version 1.1 the types are taken directly from NHS England's own Oversight Framework provider files, not judged by hand. Coverage is England for 2023/24. The CSV, source snapshots and a script are available as a free download from Zenodo under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. Caveats: trusts merge and change over time, so the table is tied to one year, and trust types are administrative labels, not legal statuses, as the producer notes. Simulation uses: linking NHS estates, cyber security, finance and workforce data to build trust-level models of hospital system resilience. Related records: the NHP demand model (model-nhp-demand-model) plans NHS hospital capacity.
